forecasts.question: Will Iran's IRGC confirm conducting a ballistic or cruise missile attack against US military assets or personnel before EOD September 16, 2026?
forecasts.delta_reason: New near-term forecast (Day 198). IRGC launched ballistic missiles at two US Navy warships Sep 5 (CNN), attacked US aircraft at Al-Tanf garrison Jordan Sep 10 (Al Jazeera Sep 11). The exchange has run at near-daily frequency since Sep 1. Trump's Sep 9 deferral of diplomacy to post-November leaves no constraint on IRGC operational tempo. Near-daily attack cadence over the Sep 1–10 window sets a high base rate for a ≥72h recurrence.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if CENTCOM or DoD officially confirms an IRGC ballistic missile, cruise missile, or drone attack against a US military asset, installation, or personnel between 2026-09-13 and EOD 2026-09-16. An attack that is attempted but fully intercepted still counts as YES (attack confirmed; interception does not negate the attempt).
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM official statement OR DoD press briefing OR Reuters/AP/AFP reporting a confirmed US military statement naming IRGC as the attacker.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A Houthi or Hezbollah attack against a US asset, even if IRGC-coordinated, does NOT count unless DoD explicitly attributes to IRGC command. An unconfirmed Iranian government claim of a successful attack, without US military confirmation, = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session (mediated, senior officials, named principals) occur before EOD 2026-09-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE. Trump told reporters Sep 9 the war would end 'immediately after the [US midterm] elections' on November 3, explicitly framing a deal as post-Nov 3 — no session before Sep 17 is consistent with his stated timeline (The National, US News, Sep 9). IAEA Board voted 23-7 on Sep 9 to refer Iran to the UN Security Council; both sides' positions hardened further. FM Araghchi's Sep 10 telephone call with Pakistan army chief Gen. Munir was characterized as message relay by Pakistani officials, not a session convening. DA partially accepted: Pezeshkian's Sep 1 conditional offer ('will return if US does') is a real observable; p moved to 0.12 rather than 0.10. SUNDAY cold-start: p_cold=0.12 (matching post-DA); gap from inherited p_prior (0.15) = 3pp, within tolerance.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar/Switzerland/Saudi Arabia), between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-17.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official mediator readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Message relay through intermediaries without a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Trump assertions of 'semi-negotiating' without Iranian or mediator confirmation of a held session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Gadi Eisenkot (Yashar) become Israel's Prime Minister by December 1, 2026?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast. Eisenkot leads Netanyahu in prime ministerial suitability by a record 52% vs 38% (Channel 12, Sep 8). Yashar-led bloc projected at 57 seats across three polls — short of the 61 required but within range with Arab party cooperation. Coalition formation in Israel typically takes 28-42 days; Eisenkot would need to be sworn in within ~33 days of Oct 27. Yashar winning the most seats (F5 at 0.32) is a necessary but not sufficient condition. P=0.32 accounts for additional uncertainty about bloc arithmetic reaching 61 and coalition formation completing by Dec 1.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Gadi Eisenkot is sworn in as Prime Minister of Israel before EOD December 1, 2026. Appointment alone without a Knesset confidence vote does NOT count; a swearing-in with a Knesset confidence vote counts even if the formal ceremony is pending.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Times of Israel / Haaretz / Reuters / AP confirming the Knesset swearing-in ceremony or confidence vote that installs Eisenkot as PM.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If Eisenkot is appointed PM-designate but has not yet secured a Knesset confidence vote by Dec 1 = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. If the October 27 election is delayed = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. If a unity government including both Eisenkot and Netanyahu is formed = AMBIGUOUS (check who holds PM title at swearing-in).
